title: Profiled compile verdict: projected rule unconditionally, DS14 companion rule only along certified sequences
statement: On the population-conditionally-centered scalar class (d_psi = d_lambda = 1): (a) the projected efficient-score interval rule is the only CURRENTLY ESTABLISHED unconditional compile path in the registered theory, not a mathematical uniqueness theorem. By the DS16 funnel, every asymptotically value-convergent free-optimizer sequence is nuisance-degenerate, so refusal to compile a free profiled terminal remains the safe default. (b) DS14 supplies only a sequence-conditional companion-rule theorem; one finite stable fit passing measured margins remains diagnostic, not a population certificate. Report the observable finite gap v_hat_K - Phi_hat_s; delta(kappa) is existential. (c) Audit-hardened DS17 proves that, on atomless (L)+(M1)+(M4) laws, almost surely all sufficiently large samples have no ordinary exchange-stable labeling satisfying fixed (M2)+(M3)+(M5), so the full-triple DS14 path is asymptotically vacuous there. With (M5) dropped, LCM stationary configurations may retain margins only in coincident projected-centroid splits whose compilable reduction has rank at most one; the Gaussian sign-split family is the exact construction, while a universal value pinning is not claimed. Outside (L), measured mix3 evidence finds a cheap population gate root, but neither general free certification nor empirical transfer is proved. The projected rule attains v_K only in the distinct formulation with nuisance information supplied externally or unbinned.
assumptions: class (L)+(S), d_psi = d_lambda = 1, equal weights, exact scores; the conditional path's asymptotic guarantee is DS14's and inherits (M1)-(M5), or the merged variant, along a sequence
a per-fit measured triple plus exact exchange stability is diagnostic only and is not a finite-sample population certificate
beyond the class (non-centered laws): measured only (mix3 keeps lambda_min = Theta(1) at terminal states); OP29's mathematical branches remain open

role: the deployment verdict OP29's packet was opened for; the target of the independent adversarial audit that gates any compile_quantizer change
warning: Audit-hardened by both AUDIT-DS-STABLE-MARGINS-COMPILE-001 and the DS17 audit. 'Only' is registry-relative, not impossibility of another compiler. Conditional centering is a population-law assumption, not sample recentering and not a general HEP/template-model property. On (L), any margin-constrained terminal is constrained, priced, and non-inductive; off (L), the gate is necessary only and mix3 is measured per-law evidence. The inherited direct dependency on measured DS-STABLE-STATE-SELECTION remains a separate audit task. No src/ surface is implemented.
